title: BackendModel
description: One model exposed by a backend Agent. This is backend menu metadata, not upstream inventory and not a Route.

id.description: The exact identifier shown to and emitted by the backend Agent. OpenCode identifiers use provider/model form. Responses may echo longer identifiers persisted by older releases; mutation admission limits newly added identifiers to 256 characters.

display_name.description: Optional human-readable label. The backend id remains the routing identity.

origin.description: How this row was first created. User edits remain authoritative regardless of origin.

models_dev_id.description: The provider/model identity selected from models.dev, or null when no match has been selected. Filling metadata later does not change an existing row's origin.

context_window.description: Maximum context tokens used by the backend for context budgeting.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens advertised to the backend.

input_modalities.description: Explicitly supported input modalities. An empty array leaves native metadata in place when the backend has it and otherwise uses that backend adapter's safe default.

output_modalities.description: Explicitly supported output modalities. An empty array leaves native metadata in place when the backend has it and otherwise uses that backend adapter's safe default.

supports_tools.description: True or false explicitly overrides tool support in the backend projection. Null omits that override and preserves the backend's own default.

supports_reasoning.description: True or false explicitly overrides reasoning support in the backend projection. Null omits that override and preserves the backend's own default.

reasoning_efforts.description: Effort values are sent verbatim unless supports_reasoning is false. False suppresses their runtime projection without deleting the list, so returning the capability to null is lossless. An empty array means the backend omits the effort parameter.

locked.description: Server-derived. A locked system row is visible but cannot be edited, removed, or reordered.

routeable.description: Server-derived. False only for a backend-owned selector such as Claude Code Default that never names a Route key.
